# llama.cpp server prefill sweep

Two timed repetitions after a prompt warmup; depth fills excluded by llama-bench. Raw JSON retained.
Peak fraction is reported only for Qwen (no FLOPs formula validated for other architectures). Peak fraction uses engine per-token FLOPs at mean timed-prompt depth D + P/2 (P = prompt tokens); peak is FP8 dense, not sparsity. Speedup denominator is pinned ub512/q8_0 for the same depth and prompt.
